Research pages bring together a calculation's question, model, settings, results,
and interpretation. Start with the conclusion, then use the plots and detailed
data to examine the comparison.

| Study | Focus | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| [Circular Pad with a Uniform port](../history/curved-source-installation.qmd) | Curved-source geometry and the environment used for a Palace Eigenmode study | Historical study; its recorded source and Solver versions stay together |

## Research and tool documentation

Use this Area for numerical comparisons and observations tied to a particular
model. The [Contract Overview](../reference.qmd) covers SCGSim's supported
behavior, inputs, outputs, and implementation checks. For example,
[Tetrahedral Mesh Quality](../mesh-quality.qmd) describes what the stored-Mesh
reader measures; it remains in Contract.

[Convention](../conventions.qmd) explains the technical terms used in both Areas.
